name: iam
summary: Terraform module for AWS IAM roles and policies
description:
Terraform module to create IAM roles and policies. With this module is possible to:
-Create an IAM role with a custom IAM policy and/or managed IAM policies attached to it
-Create an instance profile role

inputs.name: assume_role_policy
inputs.description: JSON IAM policy for assume role (either this or `trusted_service` is mandatory. Both can be specified)

inputs.name: create_role
inputs.description: Set to True to create IAM role (Default: true)

inputs.name: disable_org_check
inputs.description: Set this to true to disable the Deny permission in the trust policy which stops services from outside the Experian Organization from assuming the role

inputs.name: instance_profile_enabled
inputs.description: Create EC2 Instance Profile for the role (Default: false)

inputs.name: managed_policy_arns
inputs.description: List of managed policies to attach to created role

inputs.name: max_session_duration
inputs.description: The maximum session duration (in seconds) for the role. Can have a value from 1 hour (3600 seconds) to 12 hours (43200 seconds)

inputs.name: override_policy_name
inputs.description: Set to TRUE to override the policy name. By default, 'BUPolicyFor' is added as a prefix as per https://experian.atlassian.net/wiki/x/XwH3E

inputs.name: override_role_name
inputs.description: Set to TRUE to override the role name. By default, 'BURoleFor' is added as a prefix as per https://experian.atlassian.net/wiki/x/XwH3E

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: Path to the role and policy. See [IAM Identifiers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/reference_identifiers.html) for more information.  (Default: '/')

inputs.name: permissions_boundary
inputs.description: ARN of the policy that is used to set the permissions boundary for the role

inputs.name: policy_description
inputs.description: The description of the IAM policy that is visible in the IAM policy manager (required if `policy_documents` is not empty)

inputs.name: policy_documents
inputs.description: List of JSON IAM policy documents

inputs.name: policy_name
inputs.description: The name of the IAM policy that is visible in the IAM policy manager (required if `policy_documents` is not empty)

inputs.name: role_description
inputs.description: The description of the IAM role that is visible in the IAM role manager

inputs.name: tags
inputs.description: Tags for AWS Resources. See https://experian.atlassian.net/wiki/x/swH3E for all available tags. 'CostString', 'AppID' and 'Environment' are required

inputs.name: trusted_service
inputs.description: Name of the AWS service (e.g., `ec2`) that can assume the role (either this or `assume_role_policy` is mandatory. Both can be specified)

outputs.name: instance_profile
outputs.description: Name of the ec2 profile (if enabled)

outputs.name: role_arn
outputs.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) specifying the role

outputs.name: role_id
outputs.description: The stable and unique string identifying the role

outputs.name: role_name
outputs.description: The name of the IAM role created

outputs.name: role_policy
outputs.description: Role policy document in json format. Outputs always, independent of `enabled` variable
